children: Brand Engagement Network entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement to sell 123,650 common shares at $8.50 per share for gross proceeds of $1,051,025, a premium to the $7.07 close on Sep 21, 2026. The investment, split equally between BEN Capital Fund I and Joseph Bevash, includes an initial $150,025 followed by five monthly installments of $180,200 each through Feb 5, 2027. Each funded tranche carries 100% warrant coverage, exercisable at $8.50 for six months, matching the number of shares purchased. The deal enhances liquidity while aligning new capital with near-term milestones.
